theme_central: The Opening: praise of Allah followed by a request for guidance — recited in every unit of prayer, it sums up in 7 verses the entire relationship between the believer and their Lord.
sources_note: Universally known content, no possible divergence in structure.

branches.title: Praise and attributes of Allah
branches.resume: Praise of Allah, Lord of the worlds, the Most Merciful, Master of the Day of Recompense.

children.t: Basmala: in the name of Allah, the Most Merciful
Praise of Allah, Lord of the worlds, Master of the Day of Recompense

branches.title: Worship and guidance
branches.resume: The believer proclaims that Allah alone is worshipped and asks for His guidance on the straight path.

children.t: "It is You we worship, and You alone we ask for help"
Guidance to the straight path, that of those who have been blessed
